newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Specialty to open 80 stores in year ahead.
newsitem.headline: Specialty to open 80 stores in year ahead.

text.p: South Africa's Specialty Stores Ltd said on Monday it aims to open at least 80 new stores in the year ending March, 1998, which will up its outlets total to 540 and boost annual sales to more than 1.5 billion rand.
The firm runs five clothing retail chains made up of Mr Price, Milady's, Hub, Galaxy and Sheet Street.

"As none of our chains has reached saturation, the Specialty group clearly has the potential to show significant growth and to markedly improve its current levels of profitability," said joint chairman Stewart Cohen.

The firm also said that it expected earnings in the first half of the current year to be in line with the comparable period last year, but that the second half will see an improved performance which will be assisted by any lowering of interest rates.
Many economists are predicting South Africa will lower rates in the third quarter of this year.
